title: The report config panel is titled "Title" and the empty state says "Object Not Found" — call sites asking for a key whose value is not the copy for that slot
body:
Surfaced by #3810's census (43 call sites whose inline `defaultValue` disagreed with the `en` value). Aligning them is mechanical and correct — the pack value is what renders — but a handful of the divergences are evidence of a **different** defect: the call site is asking for a key whose value was written for another slot, so users read the wrong copy today. Those are not fixable by alignment, and they are not in #3810's scope.

## The clearest case: the report editor panel

`packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportConfigPanel.tsx:143,147` asks for `report.editor.title` for BOTH the panel's `aria-label` and its heading. That key is the **field label of the report's Title input**, not a panel name — its neighbours in `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts:1052` make that unambiguous:

```
editor: {
  breadcrumb: 'Configuration',
  basic: 'Basic',
  title: 'Title',
  titlePlaceholder: 'e.g. Pipeline by Quarter',
  description: 'Description',
  ...
```

So the panel heading reads **"Title"**, and the complementary landmark is announced as **"Title"**. The call site's own dead fallback said `'Edit report'`, which is what the author meant. Two users are affected differently: a sighted user sees an odd heading; a screen-reader user gets a landmark whose name says nothing about what the region is.

## Others from the same census

| call site | key | `en` renders | the author's dead fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.tsx:436` | `empty.objectNotFound` | `Object Not Found` | `Source object not found` |
| `app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx:315` | `sidebar.activityFeed` | `Activity feed` | `Activity` (a tab label beside `Inbox`) |
| `app-shell/src/layout/AppSidebar.tsx:647` | `layout.appSwitcher.systemConsole` | `System Console` | `System` |
| `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:1796` | `detail.unknownUser` | `Unknown` | `Unknown user` |
| `plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx:216` | `list.color` | `Color` | `Row color` |
| `app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx:330` | `home.welcome` | `Build your business system with AI` | `Welcome to {{product}}` |

Each row is one of three things, and they need different fixes — which is why this is a triage card, not a patch:

1. **Wrong key** — the slot needs a key of its own (`report.editor.panelTitle`, `empty.interfaceSourceObjectNotFound`). Adding a key obliges the other nine packs (`all-locales-key-parity`), so it is a real change, not a rename.
2. **Right key, pack copy is stale** — e.g. `list.color` really is the "Row color" section. Then the fix is an `en` edit plus the nine translations (`scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs`, #3650).
3. **Deliberate, and the fallback was simply wrong** — no action beyond what #3810 already did.

`home.welcome` carries a second, independent defect: the call site passes a `product` parameter and the `en` value has no `{{product}}` hole, so i18next drops it silently. That is the class #3845 filed (its own instance was `marketplace.action.updateTo`); noting it there too.

None of this blocks #3810 — that PR aligns all 43 call sites to the pack, which is right regardless of how these rows are judged. What it does is make the mismatch visible in one place instead of hidden behind a dead string.
